QuestInfo.name: [Riena Strait] A Warrior's Pride
QuestInfo.0: Putan wants to talk to you in Barbara's House.
QuestInfo.1: Putan has a few more things to say to you before you get your reward. Talk to him again.

1.0: And you! You are like true sailor now, master of the sea! You will have many great adventures on the open water, this I know.
1.1: Do not forget me, great sailor. Wear this forever. You are one of us now, yes?

yes.0: Here is to the great adventure!
